title: Founder Live Execution Approval Planning
objective: Define governed local approval-planning gates for future live execution without granting approval capture, runtime admission, execution, mutation, deploy, network, or spend authority.
safetyRules: No deploy, release, export, package creation, network calls, or provider spend.
No approval writes that unlock execution.
No runtime admission or live mode transition.
No raw private project IDs in primary Command Center UX.
No full Command Center demo leakage.
reuseRequired: existing dashboard cards, tabs, badges, route matrix, evidence, audit, and activity helpers

subphases.title: Approval Planning Contract / Schema Baseline
subphases.narrowGoal: Define the P105 approval-planning contract and local schema for future governed live execution approvals without enabling approval capture or execution.

expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.envelope: Result envelope with schemaVersion, currentState, sourceBoundaryPhase, approvalPlanShape, approvalGateShape, runtimeTransitionShape, requiredGates, forbiddenActions, approvalGateCount, approvalCanUnlockExecution false, approvalWriteAllowed false, runtimeAdmissionAllowed false, liveModeEscalationAllowed false, nextAction, blockers, disabledReason, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, and commandCenterVisible false.
expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.approvalPlanShape: Display-safe approval plan with planKey, displayLabel, sourcePhase, currentState, requiredGates, forbiddenActions, ownerCapability, evidenceRefs, activityLocation, costImpact, nextAction, and all blocked flags false.
expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.approvalGateShape: Display-safe gate with gateKey, displayLabel, requiredEvidence, approvalRequired true, approvalCaptured false, executionUnlockAllowed false, missingEvidence, validationCommands, blockers, disabledReason, and all blocked flags false.
expectedExportsSchemasDataShapes.runtimeTransitionShape: Display-safe transition with transitionKey, displayLabel, targetRuntimeState, transitionAllowed false, execution flags false, disabledReason, and all blocked flags false.

subphases.commandCenterUxRequirements: No Command Center source change in P105.1. Future P105.4 must render approval-planning status on Business Build, Agent Flow, and Live Readiness without unprocessed data dumps, private IDs, demo leakage, approval buttons, execution controls, or fake runnable actions. Chat with NEXUS and Lite remain chat-only.
subphases.themeRequirements: No theme source change in P105.1. Future UX must preserve system, dark, and light themes.
subphases.playwrightTests: No Playwright update in P105.1 because no UI files change. P105.4 must add focused Command Center route coverage.
subphases.docsRoadmap: Add P105 plan doc and platform roadmap section. Update README with P105.1 status.
subphases.phaseStatusUpdate: P105 in progress; P105.1 complete; current P105.1; previous P104.7; next P105.2.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm P105.1 is schema and contract only.
gitCommands: git commit -m "feat(nexus): define founder live approval planning"
